subject: Ariba onboarding: PO field enablement + MSA redline handoff
messages:
From: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@medsys.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: tom.reed@medsys.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ariba onboarding kickoff + MSA redline

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for the quick intro. We're kicking off supplier onboarding in Ariba for Redwood. Before we open the supplier record I wanted to share our portal gating checklist and clarify a couple items that typically block activation: remit-to address (separate fields), SupplierTaxID (EIN/VAT), and explicit PO acceptance terms (we need an affirmative acceptance clause, or EDI ACK).

Attached is our Ariba onboarding checklist and the PO field layout we expect for automated processing. Two asks from procurement side:
- Can Redwood accept PO acknowledgements within Ariba (we can accept EDI 997 or portal ACK)?
- Do you have any redline requests to the MSA/order form that would affect PO acceptance or invoicing flow?

Looping Tom (Ariba implementation) and Polly (our Ariba integrator) so we can align field names for the mapping.

Best,
Alicia

Attachments: MedSys_Ariba_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, PO_field_layout_MedSys.pdf

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@medsys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding kickoff + MSA redline

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — received the checklist and the PO layout. Quick response and plan:
1) I'll send an initial MSA redline (high level) to legal for review and share back by EOD. Attaching the draft redline now so your team can see the ask points (nothing dramatic — mainly clarifying PO acceptance and invoicing fields).
2) Marissa (onboarding) will own the field-mapping matrix with Polly/Tom and confirm whether we can emit an EDI 855/ACK or rely on portal confirmations.
3) Laura will confirm our position on indemnity/limit and whether the MSA redlines affect automated PO acceptance.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Friday with Tom + Polly + Marissa + Laura to finalize field names and timing. Are you available 10:00-10:30 PT?

Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_redline_Rafael_20270318.docx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@medsys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding kickoff + MSA redline

Alicia / Rafael —

I reviewed Rafael's redline. Key legal points we need to resolve before activation (summary):
- PO acceptance: Redwood prefers a "written acceptance" or passing of an EDI/portal ACK to constitute acceptance. We cannot be forced into implied acceptance via invoicing; need explicit acceptance language.
- Indemnity & Limitation of Liability: MedSys' current order form language proposes unlimited indemnity for third-party claims. We propose a mutual indemnity limited to direct damages with a combined cap tied to the total fees paid in the prior 12 months.
- Insurance: we can provide proof of insurance but certificate must be acceptable to Redwood; please confirm what fields MedSys requires on the COI.
- Invoicing/Tax fields: ensure that SupplierTaxID and remit-to are captured as discrete fields and that the PO number passed in EDI/portal equals the invoice's reference.

I attached a marked-up MSA with comments. If procurement requires changes that materially increase exposure (indemnity/insurance/litigation forum), we'll need legal sign-off and potential pricing impacts. Happy to discuss on the sync.

- Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_Legal_Comments_20270318.docx

From: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@medsys.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@medsys.com>, Polly Nguyen <polly@ariba-impl.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding kickoff + MSA redline

Laura / Rafael —

Thanks for the review. A few procurement clarifications from our side that will affect mapping:
- Our Ariba portal enforces separate fields for RemitToAddressLine1..4, RemitToCity, RemitToCountry, and a discrete TaxID field; we cannot map a single free-text remit field.
- We can emit an EDI 997 / Portal ACK to confirm receipt; however, our standard policy is that a PO is considered accepted if supplier returns an ACK within 48 hours OR if supplier invoices against the PO and the invoice passes 3-way match (we recognize this creates implied acceptance in some scenarios).
- Regarding insurance: we can accept standard COI; please confirm the insurer name and policy number on the COI you will provide.
- On indemnity: our template requires a broader indemnity for patient-data related claims — if Redwood can accept mutual carveouts tied to willful misconduct and gross negligence, we can escalate legal review internally.

We are available for the Friday sync at 10:00 PT — Tom, Polly and I will be there.

Best,
Alicia

Attachments: PO_field_layout_MedSys.pdf, MedSys_Ariba_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@medsys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Tom Reed <tom.reed@medsys.com>, Polly Nguyen <polly@ariba-impl.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding kickoff + MSA redline

Thanks team — plan moving forward:
- Marissa will produce the PO_field_mapping_matrix.xlsx (attached) by EOD Mon with exact Ariba field names (RemitToAddressLine1..4, SupplierTaxID, InvoiceReference). Marissa: please confirm whether Redwood's invoicing flow can populate the discrete remit fields.
- Laura: can you confirm final position Friday afternoon on the indemnity cap language? If there is a material gap, Rafael will flag for pricing/CS escalation.
- Alicia / Tom / Polly: on the 10:00 PT sync we'll walk the mapping and confirm whether EDI 997 is sufficient for acceptance, or if MedSys requires an affirmative portal ACK.
- Action items for MedSys: provide sample COI (fields required) and confirm whether invoice 3-way match may be treated as acceptance for advanced shipping notifications.

I've attached the initial mapping sheet and our draft redline again for reference. If everyone agrees, we'll treat legal/field mapping as the blockers for portal activation and schedule follow-up review after the sync.

Cheers,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_field_mapping_matrix.xlsx, MSA_redline_Rafael_20270318.docx, Proof_of_Insurance.pdf
